annotations.title: How a club is doing in a race

description: Shows how a club, team or coach's athletes are doing in a live race. Use it when the user asks about a club or team in a race ("How is the UCT team doing in the Comrades?") or a coach's athletes ("How are Coach Nadia's runners doing in the Comrades?"). Inputs: club (its name or page address, windline.tech/c/<club> or runfast.tech/c/<club>) or coach; event if named. Returns: each member's km, time against goal or finish time, and a map with just their dots; each person opens their live card. If several clubs or coaches match, or their people are live in several races, it lists them so the user can choose. Limits: only what the club's public live map shows: members who chose to be findable, never a private run, never a position near the start or finish. Read-only.

club.description: The club or team as the user said it ("UCT", "the UCT team", "Coast Riders"), or its page address (runfast.tech/c/uct).

coach.description: Instead of club: a coach as the user said it ("Coach Nadia", "Nadia Pillay"), or the coach id a picker gave ("runfast:coach-nadia-pillay").

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: club_in_race

outputSchema.description: A club or team in a race: its people on the club's live map, with their km and goal deltas.

can_tap_team.description: A team tap would reach at least one of them now.

club.description: The club: name, app (windline or runfast), slug, url (its page).

clubs.description: Several clubs matched: name, app, people. Ask which one.

coach.description: A coach's athletes (instead of club): name, app, slug, url, demo.

count.description: How many of the club's people are on its live map in that race.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

finished_count.description: How many of them have finished.

members.description: Each member on the club's live map (Findable): id (for where_is), name, photo, status, sub (km and goal delta, or the finish time), km (null near the start or finish), goal_delta, can_tap.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

on_course.description: How many are on the course.

options.description: A picker: each club, coach or race to choose from (id to pass back, name, app, sport, area, live_count).

pick.description: A picker: club, coach or race.

race.description: The race (or ride) its members are in.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: How a club is doing in a race
